newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Argentine stocks closed lower on profit-taking enhanced by a fall in the Dow Jones and its impact on Argentine ADRs on Wall Street, dealers said.

"Stocks felt the impact of some turbulence in the U.S. market," said Emilio Alessandro of brokers Alessandro y Compania. "The Argentine bolsa is showing some fatigue and lack of liquidity after good results in the month."
The local market rose 5.82 percent so far in November.
The leading index MerVal shed 1.13 percent to close at 603.66 points after rising 0.26 shortly after opening.
Turnover fell to $16.3 million from $21 million on Tuesday, in a very selective market.
Dealers said a Thanksgiving holiday in the U.S. Thursday will mean a decline in Argentine bolsa activity.

Major gainers among blue chips were paper-maker Celulosa up 7.21 percent, followed by petrochemical firm Ipako, ahead 3.57 percent, and gas transport company Transportadora Gas del Sur, gaining 3.41 percent.
After rising for four weeks the MerVal is finding resistance to test the 610/620 points level, dealers said.
